sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: setlist.fm windows, "Load all": Stop could still let one more page through. A page waiting its turn (one request a second) when you pressed Stop was read anyway, about half a second later. Now Stop finishes only the page already asked for; the next one is never asked, and "Load all" offers it again.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Link previews on other sites, before you press a button: on a Discogs search page a result's title has its card; on setlist.fm the site's own list does too (a setlist's Tour link, the venue box's website and Wikipedia links; a setlist's own link with the setlist.fm key), but not the Upcoming box's ticket links; on an archive.org search page the site's own result list does (an item's title; not its menu bar), although archive.org builds it in a way the previews could not reach before. On Discogs' older pages (submissions, history, images, user, ratings, sell) the MusicBrainz icons of murdos' importer get MusicBrainz's card there too.

Inside a preview window, more links open in the window instead of a new tab: a MusicBrainz link on springsteenlyrics.com, jungleland.it, brucespringsteen.it, Brucebase and archive.org now opens MusicBrainz's own window, as on discogs.com and setlist.fm (its Live page and editing history are read with your musicbrainz.org login, as there). A Brucebase gig, venue or person page now shows Brucebase's own card and window wherever you are, on MusicBrainz too (under "Preview event, venue and people pages on hover"), so a Brucebase show window's own gig page opens in the window. On Brucebase itself, a show link of the form brucebase.wikidot.com/1985#130185 in a window opens that show in the window.
A Discogs window opens a clicked link in the window even before its record has loaded; until now such a click opened a new tab.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: "All credits on Discogs ↗" in a Discogs artist window opened the same artist again inside the window; it opens Discogs' credits page in a new tab, as its ↗ says. The same for "A table: show it on Wikipedia ↗" in a Wikipedia window, which could reopen the same article in the window when the article had been reached by a redirect or another spelling of its name.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: The non-MusicBrainz coverage report (NON-MB-COVERAGE.html / .org, built from docs/non-mb-coverage.json) lists no open gaps: G1 to G8 of the first report are fixed. scripts/probe-ia-shadow-links.js is a console probe for archive.org's search page, to confirm the shape of its result links in a real browser.
